facts.fact: The General Information Authority announced on 19 November 2025 the pilot phases of the second level of the LY-DNID digital identity system as part of implementing the National Digital Transformation Strategy 2023-2030, citing the first level's adoption in a number of institutions and measuring it against no strategy target.

systems.tiers: level one G2G in a number of institutions; level two in pilot

note: Class left empty: the document names the strategy and its 2023-2030 period but does not describe its scope; it states nothing on publication of the text, so no period or standing fact is recorded.
